scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/hello/index.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist/hello --entry-naming index.mjs
scripts.test: bun run test:bun && bun run test:vitest
scripts.invoke: bun run build && bun ../../scripts/local/profile.ts sam-env > ../../.local/sam-env.json && sam local invoke HelloFunction --event events/hello.json --env-vars ../../.local/sam-env.json
scripts.start-api: bun run build && bun ../../scripts/local/profile.ts sam-env > ../../.local/sam-env.json && sam local start-api --port 3000 --env-vars ../../.local/sam-env.json
